name: KaiMail Basic Free
free_limit: Free hosted custom-domain email forwarding: 1 domain, 1 mailbox, up to 300 received emails/month, 1 MB maximum message size and 1-day log retention; ARC/DKIM signing.
watch_out: Inbound forwarding only; no SMTP sending or webhook delivery on Basic. Requires control of a custom domain and DNS configuration. Credit-card requirement, over-limit handling and commercial-use permission are not explicitly confirmed; check provider before production use.
